# WO-107: Remove the remaining absolute privacy claims (families, developers, whats-coming)
Status: open
Vendor: codex
Agent: web-builder
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (channel)
Assigned to: Codex channel session (Nora dispatches)
Source: CLAUDE-003 reviewer finding (follow-up to WO-101)

## Goal
Three pages still promise more than the app does. Make them accurate, in the same plain voice as WO-101's approved promise ("Your details are stored only on your computer. They go out only in a removal request you approve, sent straight to that one site.").
1. web/src/pages/families/index.astro line ~51: optional details "are never sent to anyone". That's wrong: a phone number can be included in a removal request. Say these details help find the right listing and are sent only when a site's removal form asks for them, in a request you approve.
2. web/src/pages/developers/index.astro line ~114: "Your profile and records stay on the box you control." Say they are stored on the box you control and go out only in the removal requests you approve.
3. web/src/pages/whats-coming/index.astro line ~116: heading "Your details stay with you." Use a heading that doesn't claim they never leave (e.g. "Your details are stored with you."); keep the sentence after it accurate.
Also fix the legacy v2 copy in site_src/templates/pages/families.html (same claim), and update the source comments that quote "never sent to anyone".

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- New tests/test_web_privacy_claims_followup.py (built-site test; the `test_web_` prefix makes CI run it in pages.yml): the built /families/, /developers/ and /whats-coming/ pages contain none of "never sent to anyone", "stay on the box", "stay with you", and each still states where the details are stored.
- WO-101's tests/test_web_privacy_wording.py still passes. Build, `pnpm check`, content_check and ruff pass.
- No other copy changes, no layout, CSS, link or ID changes.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- web/src/pages/families/index.astro
- web/src/pages/developers/index.astro
- web/src/pages/whats-coming/index.astro
- site_src/templates/pages/families.html
- tests/test_web_privacy_claims_followup.py
- VENDOR_STATUS.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
docs/HELPER_GUIDE.md and other docs (in-house updates them), web/src/pages/index.astro (reserved for WO-103), shared components, and site/ (the owner rebuilds it).

## Test commands
Inside `.vendor-wt/wo-107`: borrow `../../web/node_modules` (symlink, removed afterwards), `pnpm build && pnpm check`, `python3 web/scripts/content_check.py web/dist`, then `PYTHONPATH=src ../../.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_web_privacy_claims_followup.py tests/test_web_privacy_wording.py` and `../../.venv/bin/ruff check src tests`.
